segments.name: Truckload
segments.description: Over-the-road freight transportation by company drivers and owner-operators, including dedicated and network configurations, for customers across North America.
segments.evidence: Our Truckload segment competes with thousands of dry van and specialty equipment carriers.

segments.name: Intermodal
products: Door-to-door container on flat car service
segments.description: Door-to-door container on flat car service combining rail and dray transportation for shippers needing intermodal capacity.
segments.evidence: The Intermodal reportable segment provides rail intermodal and drayage services using Company-owned containers, chassis, and dray tractors.

segments.name: Logistics
segments.description: Asset-light brokerage, supply chain, warehousing and import/export services that manage customers' freight using company and third-party capacity.
segments.evidence: In the Logistics segment, we provide additional sources of truck capacity, manage transportation-systems analysis requirements for individual customers, and provide transloading and warehousing services.

revenueModel.text: Customers across multiple end markets pay the company for truckload, intermodal, logistics, leasing and insurance services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenue comes from a broad customer base spanning multiple end markets, including consumer products, retail, automotive, chemicals, electronics and appliances, e-commerce, home improvement, and food and beverage.

changes.text: In 2024 the Cowan logistics operations were integrated into the Logistics reportable segment.
changes.evidence: In December 2024, Cowan's logistics operations were integrated into the Logistics reportable segment.

changes.text: In 2023 the acquired M&M dedicated carrier results were reported within the Truckload segment.
changes.evidence: The operating results of M&M are reported in Dedicated operations as part of our Truckload segment beginning in the third quarter of 2023.
